title: Road to Champ 4!
transcript: I failed again. I played a master-level chess tournament and I lost every single round. Thousands of people saw me give away drawn [music] positions and winning positions, all until the last game, where I played one of the weirdest second moves I've ever played and I got one of the best wins of my career. You see, I knew going into the tournament that I was going to lose almost every game, but I didn't care. It's about the journey. [music] It's about learning and now I know what I need to work on. I know what my weaknesses are and my strengths. After all, who knows better than me that fools will resign. The road [music] to champion has only just begun and now that I know what the missing piece is, I can finally start to put together this puzzle and challenge myself with [music] the biggest chess festival in the entire world and the world better be ready for me because one day I will become a champion.
